content: कदम्बः, -कदम्बकः [कद् करणे अम्बच् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A kind of tree [Stephegyne Parviflora Korth] (said to put forth buds at the roaring of thunder-clouds); कतिपयकुसुमोद्गमः कदम्बः <ls>U. 3. 20</ls>, <ls n="U. 3.">42</ls>; <ls>Māl. 3. 7</ls>; <ls>Me. 25</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 99</ls>; मुक्त्वा कदम्ब-कुटजार्जुन-सर्ज-नीपान् <ls>Ṛs. 3. 13</ls>. The tree is common throughout India except in Konkan. Its fruit is hard and inedible. .²2 A kind of grass. .²3 Turmeric. .²4 The mustard-seed plant. .²5 A particular mineral substance. .²6 Dust. .²7 Fragrance; <ab>cf.</ab> कदम्बः पुंसि नीपे स्यात्तिनिशे वरुणद्रुमे . धूल्यां समूहे गन्धे च … <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-म्बी@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (देवदाली). <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 18</ls>. .{@-म्बम्@} A multitude. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A multitude, group; छायाबद्धकदम्बकं मृगकुलं रोमन्थमभ्यस्यतु <ls>Ś. 2. 6</ls>. .²2 The flower of the Kadamba tree; पृथुकदम्बकदम्बकराजितम् <ls>Ki. 5. 9</ls>. .²3 A kind of grass (देवताड).
